academy.name: ANC CC Ops Academy
academy.tagline: Campaign Communications Command Centre Operations & Digital Governance
academy.hero_description: The official qualification and operations curriculum for the African National Congress (ANC) Campaign Communications Command Centre. Engineered by CEDEC Africa for national communicators, desk officers, researchers, and field leadership.
academy.certification: CEDEC Africa Certified Campaign Operations Specialist (CCOS)

lessons.title: System Architecture, Clearance Tiers & Command Desks
lessons.subtitle: National Command, Provincial nodes, and the 6 operational roles
lessons.overview: The ANC Campaign Communications Command Centre is an integrated digital command platform engineered by CEDEC Africa. It fuses strategic campaign coordination, 2-hour rapid response rebuttal, sovereign voter engagement, and media monitoring into one unified, auditable environment.
keyPoints: Strict division of labor: six discrete operator roles with least-privilege enforcement
National Director, Ops Officer, Rapid-Response Lead, Fact-Checker/Researcher, Communicator/Spokesperson, Field Coordinator
Every action requires a cryptographically validated, single-use sign-off record
Built on sovereign South African infrastructure hosted under cedec.io and binteca.io
operationalProcedures: 1. Understand the hierarchy: National Command sets strategy and lines; Provincial/Regional nodes execute localized messaging.
2. Observe role restrictions: Communicators cannot sign dispatches; researchers verify facts but do not publish.
3. Verify channel availability: Check desk status indicators before initiating cross-platform broadcasts.
takeaways: Never share credentials or bypass the sign-off gate.
All operations are permanently logged to an immutable audit record.
The command centre guarantees operational continuity even when external platforms fail.

quiz.question: Which of the following is NOT one of the six primary operational roles in ANC CC Ops?
options: Ops Officer
Rapid-Response Lead
Chief Platform Hacker
Fact-Checker / Researcher
quiz.explanation: The six official roles are National Director, Ops Officer, Rapid-Response Lead, Fact-Checker/Researcher, Communicator/Spokesperson, and Field Coordinator.

quiz.question: Why does the command centre enforce strict role segregation?
options: To slow down response times
To ensure POPIA compliance, legal liability protection, and single-use accountability
Because the database cannot handle multiple logins
To restrict provincial teams from seeing campaign manifestos
quiz.explanation: Strict role segregation guarantees that no single operator can draft, certify, and unilaterally dispatch communications without multi-party verification and compliance clearance.

lessons.title: Perimeter Security, Authentication & First-Run Setup
lessons.subtitle: Edge perimeter gate unlock, credentials, and session management
lessons.overview: Access to ANC CC Ops is safeguarded by an estate-level perimeter security gate (Rule #31) followed by role-authenticated session credentials. This lesson walks through unlocking the edge gate, initial credential authentication, and security hygiene.
keyPoints: Estate perimeter gate password protects pre-production and staging environments
Authentication uses email and high-entropy passwords with secure HttpOnly cookie tokens
First-run password rotation is mandatory for all newly issued operator accounts
Immediate session termination occurs if an account is deactivated in Administration
operationalProcedures: 1. Connect to the platform URL and authenticate past the edge security gate if prompted.
2. Enter your assigned email address and initial password.
3. On first login in production, navigate to your profile and set a new personal password.
4. Familiarize yourself with the shell header: polls countdown, active campaign line, and role pill.
takeaways: Session cookies are strictly scoped to the domain with SameSite=Lax and Secure flags.
Admin accounts can revoke active operator sessions immediately upon security suspicion.

quiz.question: What is the primary purpose of the edge perimeter gate?
options: To collect user email addresses for marketing
To prevent unauthorized indexing, scanning, and public exposure of operational environments
To slow down the internet connection
To replace username and password sign-in
quiz.explanation: The edge perimeter gate ensures the operational command surface is shielded from external port scanners, crawlers, and unauthorized network reconnaissance.

lessons.title: The 3-Way Certification Sign-Off Gate & Legal Compliance
lessons.subtitle: The consumable sign-off record, certifications, and one-time execution
lessons.overview: Anything that opens a case, logs a situation, approves a draft, signs a deliverable, or sends a broadcast MUST pass through the sign-off gate. The gate is not a simple confirmation dialog—it generates an immutable database certification consumed exactly once.
keyPoints: The gate writes WHO, as WHICH ROLE, WHAT action, and the 3 mandatory certifications
Certification 1: Factual accuracy verified against primary evidence
Certification 2: Strategic alignment with the National Campaign line
Certification 3: Compliance with the IEC Electoral Code of Conduct & POPIA
A sign-off record cannot be reused, presented by someone else, or altered
operationalProcedures: 1. Prepare deliverable or broadcast draft in the relevant operational desk.
2. Trigger 'Submit to Sign-Off Gate'.
3. Select your active authorized role from the dropdown.
4. Review and tick each of the three mandatory legal certifications.
5. Confirm sign-off to execute the dispatch and lock the audit record.
takeaways: Actions without a valid sign-off are blocked at the application API layer.
Signing false information creates individual legal liability under the Electoral Act.

quiz.question: What happens to a sign-off record once the action is executed?
options: It can be reused for the next 24 hours
It is permanently consumed and can never be reused or transferred
It is deleted from the database to save space
It is emailed to all political opponents
quiz.explanation: A sign-off record is consumed exactly once by the system, ensuring complete, tamper-proof accountability.

lessons.title: Daily Ops & Review Desk: Campaign Command & Schedule
lessons.subtitle: 24-hour campaign schedule, Message Bank search & real-time draft review
lessons.overview: Daily Ops is the heartbeat of campaign communications. It orchestrates the daily narrative across television, radio, print, digital, and grassroots networks, synchronizing scheduled broadcasts with real-time editorial approval.
keyPoints: Campaign Schedule: 24-hour chronological timeline of planned dispatches and media moments
Message Bank: centralized archive of approved talking points, press lines, and Q&A guides
Review Queue: incoming draft statements reviewed by editorial officers before gate dispatch
Search & Reuse: instant retrieval of verified historical statements to ensure message consistency
operationalProcedures: 1. Start the morning by reviewing the 24-hour Campaign Schedule and the 07:00 Order of the Day.
2. When drafting communications, search the Message Bank for approved national lines.
3. Submit novel lines to the Review Desk for editorial assessment and senior approval.
4. Monitor scheduled dispatch statuses: Draft, In Review, Approved, Dispatched, or Refused.
takeaways: Never draft ungrounded communications when approved lines exist in the Message Bank.
All departures from the national campaign line must be formally approved.

quiz.question: What is the primary function of the Message Bank?
options: To store WhatsApp chat backups
To provide a centralized repository of approved talking points and historical press lines
To process financial donations
To design print billboards
quiz.explanation: The Message Bank maintains the authoritative, approved corporate memory of talking points and official statements.

lessons.title: 2-Hour Rapid Rebuttal Engine: 5-Stage Escalation Clock
lessons.subtitle: Crisis logging, 120-minute SLA countdown & Counter-Active Playbook
lessons.overview: When hostile media narratives, leaked audio, or viral disinformation emerge, the 2-Hour Rapid Rebuttal Engine activates. A strict 120-minute countdown governs five sequential deliverables from fact ingestion to spokesperson deployment.
keyPoints: Stage 1 (0-15m): Ingestion, viral trajectory analysis, and fact-checking
Stage 2 (15-30m): Holding statement publication across active channels
Stage 3 (30-60m): Strategic analysis & Counter-Active Playbook generation
Stage 4 (60-90m): Comprehensive Spokesperson Pack & broadcast talking points
Stage 5 (90-120m): Multi-channel dispatch, media briefing, and field coordination
operationalProcedures: 1. Click 'Log Breaking Situation', enter the claim, source URL/media, and severity level.
2. The 120-minute SLA countdown timer initiates immediately.
3. Ingest primary evidence and assign verification tasks to researchers.
4. Generate and sign off the holding statement within 30 minutes.
5. Produce the Counter-Active Playbook with targeted attack lines and spokesperson directives.
takeaways: The 2-hour SLA is absolute. Breaching SLA triggers automated escalation alerts.
A holding line must be released before the full rebuttal is finalized to seize the narrative vacuum.

quiz.question: What is the maximum time allocated for releasing the initial holding statement?
options: 15 minutes
30 minutes
2 hours
24 hours
quiz.explanation: Stage 2 mandates that a verified holding statement must be cleared through the gate within 30 minutes of incident logging.

lessons.title: WeVote Sovereign Web Chatbot & Social Media Army Network
lessons.subtitle: Browser-based sovereign voter engagement and grassroots mobilization
lessons.overview: Due to Meta's aggressive commerce policy bans on political automation, CEDEC Africa engineered the WeVote Sovereign Web Chatbot. Hosted independently on sovereign servers, it delivers a rich, conversational interface without third-party app store bans.
keyPoints: Hosted at https://chat.wevoteanc.cedec.io (and https://chat.wevoteanc.org.za)
Full browser access on mobile, tablet, and desktop without WhatsApp API fees or ban risks
Localised semantic RAG: answers grounded in all 52 municipal manifestos and ward candidate rosters
Social Media Army: task coordination for volunteer digital canvassers with trackable amplification links
operationalProcedures: 1. Direct voters to the sovereign chatbot URL via QR codes, SMS, and campaign flyers.
2. Verify voter input handling: ward identification, candidate bios, and local service delivery commitments.
3. Use the Social Media Army desk to assign approved digital tasks to volunteer cadres.
4. Monitor volunteer task completion and content share counts in real time.
takeaways: Sovereign hosting protects campaign communications from foreign platform censorship.
All volunteer mobilization links strictly prohibit deceptive engagement or coordinated astroturfing.

quiz.question: Why did CEDEC Africa build the WeVote sovereign web chatbot instead of relying solely on the WhatsApp Cloud API?
options: Because WhatsApp is too difficult to code
To eliminate Meta platform bans, political messaging restrictions, and commercial API fees
Because South Africans do not have smartphones
To avoid translating content into indigenous languages
quiz.explanation: Meta strictly prohibits political campaigning and automated bots on WhatsApp Business; sovereign web hosting eliminates this vulnerability.

lessons.title: 07:00 Morning Intel Desk: Sentiment & Telemetry Analytics
lessons.subtitle: Cross-platform analytics, SLA health, narrative impact, and 14-day trends
lessons.overview: Every morning at 07:00, leadership receives an objective situational report computed directly from system records. It tracks response times, narrative penetration, channel dispatches, and public sentiment trends.
keyPoints: Computed metrics: open situations, average holding statement minutes, SLA adherence rates
Channel performance: dispatches sent, refused, and delivery rates across digital and press channels
14-day rolling telemetry chart visualizing campaign operational tempo
'Fetch channel metrics' live integration with X, Facebook Page Insights, and web traffic
operationalProcedures: 1. Access the 07:00 Morning Intel desk prior to daily strategy briefings.
2. Review SLA compliance metrics from the preceding 24 hours.
3. Check for any situations currently marked 'Past SLA' and request root-cause analyses.
4. Use trend charts to determine resource allocation between rebuttal and positive narrative desks.
takeaways: If no data was recorded for a channel, the panel displays 'no data'—never simulated or faked numbers.
Morning intel grounds daily campaign decisions in hard data rather than subjective impressions.

quiz.question: What is the primary objective of the 07:00 Morning Intel report?
options: To entertain campaign staff with social media memes
To provide an objective, data-backed operational assessment of SLA compliance and narrative impact
To replace the national election results
To assign disciplinary penalties to field workers
quiz.explanation: 07:00 Morning Intel provides leadership with verified, empirical operational telemetry to guide daily strategic decisions.

lessons.title: Facebook Campaign Manager & Micro-Targeting
lessons.subtitle: Demographic segmenting, budget allocation, compliance gates & feature flags
lessons.overview: The Facebook Campaign Manager allows campaign strategists to configure precision social outreach campaigns. It provides ward-level geographic targeting, demographic budgeting, and mandatory compliance routing.
keyPoints: Precision targeting: configure age, gender, language, municipality, and ward boundaries
Budget governance: define daily and lifetime caps with automatic pacing controls
Feature Flag Architecture: dormant by default in Tranche 1 (ANCOPS_FEATURE_FBADS=0)
Full compliance verification before Meta Marketing API payload dispatch
operationalProcedures: 1. Configure ad creative, headline, primary copy, and call-to-action link.
2. Define audience parameters based on municipal demographic priorities.
3. Set budget limits and duration schedule.
4. Route through the 3-Way Sign-off Gate for legal and compliance certification.
takeaways: In Tranche 1 deployments, this module is preserved in codebase but dormant until commercial activation.
All political advertising must comply with IEC campaign spending disclosures.

quiz.question: How is the Facebook Campaign Manager controlled in the platform codebase?
options: It is deleted from production
It is managed via feature flag ANCOPS_FEATURE_FBADS which safely returns 404 when disabled
It runs automatically without authorization
It requires a Facebook login on the server
quiz.explanation: The feature flag ANCOPS_FEATURE_FBADS preserves the code while safely restricting execution in Tranche 1.

lessons.title: OSINT & Media Forensics: Narrative Provenance & Verification
lessons.subtitle: Dossier creation, provenance hashes, deepfake detection & evidence preservation
lessons.overview: The Investigations Desk provides military-grade open source intelligence (OSINT) and digital media forensics. It enables researchers to trace viral smear campaigns back to their source, verify video authenticities, and preserve court-ready evidence.
keyPoints: Case Dossiers: structured evidence containers with strict POPIA Section 11 lawful basis recording
Media Forensics: SHA-256 media hashing, reverse image lookup, audio spectral analysis
Narrative Timeline: reconstructing who published what, at what exact second, across platforms
Feature Flag Architecture: dormant by default in Tranche 1 (ANCOPS_FEATURE_OSINT=0)
operationalProcedures: 1. Open a new investigative dossier and state the specific POPIA lawful purpose.
2. Upload contested media (video clip, audio note, forged letterhead).
3. Compute forensic hash and query integrated search indexes for earliest known occurrence.
4. Compile forensic findings into an evidence brief for the Rapid Rebuttal desk.
takeaways: No investigation may record special personal information (race, religion, health, sexual orientation).
Evidence preserved in dossiers is immutable and timestamped for regulatory submission.

quiz.question: What is required BEFORE an OSINT case dossier can be opened?
options: Approval from the state president
A recorded lawful basis under POPIA Section 11 and a strictly public-role subject definition
A payment of R5,000
A court order
quiz.explanation: POPIA Section 11 requires a documented lawful basis before collecting public intelligence data.

lessons.title: Digital Campaign Intelligence Platform (DCIP) Fusion
lessons.subtitle: National & Provincial executive command, field quotas & voter turnout
lessons.overview: The Digital Campaign Intelligence Platform (DCIP) is the executive fusion console for the National Officials and Provincial Executive Committees. It aggregates field canvassing reports, voter contact quotas, and real-time election day turnout projections.
keyPoints: National Executive Dashboard: unified overview of all 9 provinces and 52 districts
Field Canvassing Quotas: tracking progress against door-to-door voter contact targets
Provincial Roll-up: comparing regional delivery speeds and voter sentiment shifts
Election Day Operations: real-time voting station incident tracking and turnout modeling
operationalProcedures: 1. Access the DCIP console using authorized executive credentials.
2. Inspect provincial progress bars against targeted voter contacts.
3. Drill down into lagging districts to identify communication bottlenecks.
4. Coordinate targeted rapid response dispatches directly to regional field coordinators.
takeaways: DCIP connects high-level national strategy with granular on-the-ground operational reality.
Field reports must be validated against provincial coordinator sign-offs.

quiz.question: What role does the DCIP module serve in the campaign ecosystem?
options: It designs campaign t-shirts
It acts as the executive intelligence fusion center linking national strategy with field operational telemetry
It manages bank loans
It replaces the IEC election counting system
quiz.explanation: DCIP unifies all intelligence streams—canvassing, media sentiment, and voter contact metrics—into one executive console.

lessons.title: Electoral Wards, GIS Mapping & Candidate Rosters
lessons.subtitle: 4,468 wards, 213 municipalities, 8,836 certified IEC candidates
lessons.overview: South African local government elections are fought ward by ward. ANC CC Ops incorporates the complete geospatial boundaries of all 4,468 electoral wards across 213 local and metropolitan municipalities, integrated with 8,836 certified IEC candidate profiles.
keyPoints: Complete national coverage: all 9 provinces, 52 districts/metros, 213 local municipalities, 4,468 wards
Certified Candidate Rosters: 8,836 verified ANC candidates with bios, photos, and contact protocols
GIS Mapping Layer: visual choropleth maps displaying historical margins and target priorities
Grounding Database: powers the candidate lookup feature in the sovereign WeVote chatbot
operationalProcedures: 1. Open the Electoral Wards Inspector to search by municipality name or ward number.
2. View the certified candidate profile, contact details, and historical victory margin.
3. Verify ward boundaries against Municipal Demarcation Board (MDB) legal definitions.
4. Use ward candidate details to tailor localized press statements and rebuttal packs.
takeaways: Candidate rosters are immutable once certified by the IEC.
The chatbot relies directly on this data to provide instant voter answers to 'Who is my candidate?'.

quiz.question: How many certified ANC candidates are indexed in the CC Ops platform database?
options: 500 candidates
2,500 candidates
8,836 candidates
50,000 candidates
quiz.explanation: The database contains all 8,836 officially registered and certified candidates covering all wards and PR lists.

lessons.title: Localised Manifestos & Semantic RAG Grounding
lessons.subtitle: 52 municipal manifestos, 850+ indexed semantic chunks & vector search
lessons.overview: Voters care about water in Hammanskraal, electricity in Soweto, and roads in Central Karoo. ANC CC Ops breaks the national manifesto into 52 localized municipal manifestos indexed into 850+ semantic chunks to ground AI responses with zero hallucinations.
keyPoints: 52 localized municipal manifestos covering every district and metropolitan municipality in SA
850+ semantic text chunks indexed with high-dimensional vector embeddings
Zero-hallucination policy grounding: the WeVote chatbot answers voter policy questions exclusively from this corpus
Offline manifesto browser for desk officers and communicators
operationalProcedures: 1. Browse the Localised Manifestos catalog by province and district.
2. Inspect specific commitments (housing, water, sanitation, local economic development).
3. Test query embeddings in the RAG simulator to see which paragraphs ground the answer.
4. Quote exact manifesto paragraph commitments in official press releases.
takeaways: Never let an AI model answer voter policy questions without semantic RAG grounding.
Localized commitments take precedence over generic national bullet points.

quiz.question: What prevents the WeVote chatbot from hallucinating promises the ANC did not make?
options: A human types every single reply
Semantic RAG vector grounding that constrains generation to 850+ indexed municipal manifesto chunks
Disabling the internet connection
Using a 1990s chatbot algorithm
quiz.explanation: Semantic Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) grounds all model answers in the verified, published text of the 52 municipal manifestos.

lessons.title: External Adapter Infrastructure & Failure Tolerances
lessons.subtitle: Channel adapters, status pills, and graceful 'not configured' degradation
lessons.overview: Every connection to external services (Meta Graph API, X API, Postmark mail, search providers) is built as an isolated adapter. If an external credential is missing or revoked, the platform degrades gracefully without failing.
keyPoints: Adapter Pattern: isolated interfaces for social platforms, email relays, and search providers
Status Pills: every desk explicitly shows which external adapters are ready or disconnected
Refusal Logging: if a channel is missing keys, dispatches are recorded as 'refused' with the missing setting named
Zero Silent Failures: operators are never left wondering if an API call succeeded
operationalProcedures: 1. Observe the desk status pills: Green (Ready), Grey (Not Configured), Red (Service Unavailable).
2. When attempting dispatch through an unconfigured channel, review the explicit error message.
3. Contact platform administrators to update environment variables in /etc/jcds/env/.
4. Never attempt manual API hacks or hardcode tokens into application code.
takeaways: Connecting a channel is purely an environment configuration change; no code changes required.
Missing credentials will never crash the command centre server.

quiz.question: What happens when an operator attempts to dispatch to a channel that has no API key configured?
options: The server crashes and deletes the database
The dispatch is cleanly recorded as 'refused' with the exact missing setting named, leaving the desk intact
The system pretends it was sent and gives a fake success
An error email is sent to the public
quiz.explanation: Per estate standards, the platform refuses cleanly and logs the missing setting without crashing or falsifying delivery.

lessons.title: POPIA Compliance, Electoral Code of Conduct & Audit Chains
lessons.subtitle: Lawful basis, privacy safeguards, audit logs & legal defensibility
lessons.overview: Campaigning operates under the rule of law. ANC CC Ops strictly enforces the Protection of Personal Information Act (POPIA) and the Independent Electoral Commission (IEC) Electoral Code of Conduct at every software layer.
keyPoints: POPIA Section 11 lawful basis must be established before storing voter contact records
Strict prohibition against collecting or storing special personal information (health, ethnicity, religion)
Opt-in consent and immediate one-click opt-out for all voter communications
Immutable, timestamped audit chains admissible in Electoral Court dispute proceedings
operationalProcedures: 1. Ensure all voter phone numbers collected in the field have documented opt-in consent.
2. When a voter requests to be removed, immediately process the opt-out in the database.
3. Never draft attack lines containing unverified personal allegations or hate speech.
4. Always verify that dispatches are certified under the Electoral Code before submission.
takeaways: Compliance is not optional: breaches risk multimillion-rand fines and party disqualification.
Every user sign-in, sign-off, dispatch, and refusal is permanently logged with IP and timestamp.

quiz.question: Which of the following data types is STRICTLY FORBIDDEN from being collected or stored in ANC CC Ops?
options: Voter ward number
Special personal information (race, religion, health, criminal records)
Candidate contact phone number
Public media statements
quiz.explanation: POPIA strictly restricts special personal information; ANC CC Ops prompts and validation logic forbid storing it.

lessons.title: Platform Administration, User Provisioning & Campaign Countdown
lessons.subtitle: User provisioning, area scopes, phase transitions, and security logs
lessons.overview: The Administration console gives platform administrators complete governance over user accounts, regional area assignments, campaign timeline countdowns, and security access logs.
keyPoints: Account Provisioning: issue username, name, email, roles, and geographical area
Area Scopes: National command or restricted Provincial/Regional access (DCIP)
Campaign Phase Control: transition from Manifesto Launch to Voter Registration to GOTV (Get Out The Vote)
Countdown Timer: header countdown to election day and special voting deadlines
operationalProcedures: 1. Access the Administration menu (Admin accounts only).
2. Provision new operator accounts, selecting the precise role and province/municipality scope.
3. Update campaign settings: polling date, campaign line, and active phase.
4. Review the security Access Log daily for unauthorized login attempts or abnormal activity.
takeaways: Deactivating an account instantly terminates all active sessions across all devices.
Campaign phase transitions automatically update talking points across all desks.

quiz.question: What happens when an administrator deactivates an operator account?
options: Nothing happens until tomorrow morning
All active sessions are instantly terminated and access is immediately revoked across all desks
The operator is sent a warning letter
The account is given to someone else
quiz.explanation: Account deactivation immediately destroys valid session tokens, locking the operator out instantly.
